missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: Which products have been in stock for over 6 months without being reordered?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: Are there any size variants that have a significantly different stock count compared to other sizes of the same product?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Analysis
missions.query: Which suppliers have consistently delayed shipments, resulting in stockouts and lost sales?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: Have any products' stock levels fallen below their reorder points, potentially leading to stockouts and lost sales?

missions.name: Channel-Specific Sales Trends
missions.query: Are there any sales channels (e.g., online, in-store) where sales of specific products are significantly higher or lower than average?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Analysis
missions.query: How do different suppliers' lead times impact the timing of restocking and sales events?

missions.name: Color-Specific Sales Trends
missions.query: Are there any product colors that are consistently selling at a higher or lower rate than other colors of the same product?

missions.name: Stock Count Inconsistencies
missions.query: Are there any discrepancies between the stock counts reported by different locations or at different times?
